body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below — every level a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance (caching, event-driven, zero idle cost); (3) **full vanilla parity on non-current maps** so mods touching those APIs "just work", as if one big map.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection, foreign types in method bodies only. ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. **See-below / cross-gap is ONLY sky<->surface**; basement is routing-only.
- Basement default is solid rock; **with Biomes! Caverns loaded it generates as a living cavern (2026-07-21)**.
- Stairwells do NOT exchange heat between levels (user directive, run-14).
- Sky-view mountain = ONE connected vanilla rock texture per stone type; native walls keep vanilla edge lips; fogged deep interior = vanilla fog. USER-VERIFIED run #17, RE-VERIFIED post-rework (vanilla regression run, 2026-07-22). **Better Mountains variant mode is the sanctioned exception: when BM swaps a rock to Graphic_Random, the cap fill mirrors BM's own lip-less painterly look. USER-VERIFIED 2026-07-22.**
- **THE OUTERMOST RING OF ANY SKY MASS IS ALWAYS AB_MountainTop lip (KindLedge)** — meadows start 1 cell back exactly like ledges (run #43 regression, fixed).
- **MINED PEAK EXPOSES OPEN SKY**: gates are `level == 1`; with additional map levels they MUST become "topmost level of the column". Comments at both sites.
- **Pod transit handoff is LATE**: `HandoffTicksToImpact = 22`.
- **DEPTH/HEIGHT CUES RETIRED (2026-07-22, user direction, run #50)**: ALL painted depth/height treatments are out — parallax, south shift, descending faces, ascending facades, contact shadows, bright lips. The below view stays PLUMB (exact mapping — keep this), lightly dimmed (belowDim 0.06), thin uniform edge hairlines, wall-top reveal. Do NOT reintroduce painted depth cues without explicit user direction. The "3dish isometric camera tilt" want lives in the separate Isometric View prototype mod. Save point tags: `pre-height-language`, `pre-compat-tranche`, `pre-cue-removal`.
- **ARCHITECTURE DECISION (2026-07-22)**: single-map "mesa model" rejected (amputates under-mountain interiors, mineable-peak reveal, sky building over open ground). Stacked maps stay.
- **ALWAYS read `def.graphicData.Graphic` (live), never the stale `def.graphic` field, when classifying/harvesting rock appearance** — run-53 lesson, saved to lore (things). Caches key on the live Graphic reference (doubles as invalidation when retexture mods re-apply).

## Below-view rendering — current state (post cue-removal, USER-VERIFIED 2026-07-22)
- Transform: pure altitude drop (BelowOffset -2.5). ScreenToBelowPos = identity passthrough (single inversion point). ApplyDrawShift = y only.
- Mask: air-cells-only, fog-opaque, belowDim 0.06 (scribe key belowDimHeight).
- Skirt: ONE thin dark hairline against every adjacent slab edge (drawSlabEdge); cap borders excluded.
- Wall-top reveal (drawWallReveal + wallRevealWidth) unchanged — the one surviving rim dressing.
- SectionLayer_ABWallFacade: retired shell. SectionLayer_ABRimFacade: deleted (see git history).
- Below things: printed per air cell; multi-cell anchor = FIRST occupied cell under open air (MO fix); shrink 0.85 EXCEPT linked graphics AND rock/ores by def (mineable || isNaturalRock) — BM-proof.

## COMPAT TRANCHE (2026-07-22) — **ALL USER-VERIFIED** (BM+MO run, then vanilla regression run)
1. **Sky biome inheritance** (`skyBiomeInherit`, default ON): pocket map PrimaryBiome = surface biome at creation (deep-scribed). Regrowth/wild plants/trees/weather follow. Existing saves keep birth biome; AB_OpenSky stays for toggle-off/legacy. Peak self-test passes on inherited biome (runs #50-53).
2. **Medieval Overhaul rock formations**: below-print anchor = first air-covered occupied cell (generic multi-cell fix). MO formations mineable => never reveal candidates.
3. **Better Mountains variant mode** (cap layer): live-graphic detection (graphicData.Graphic, NOT the stale def.graphic field — the run-53 bug); non-linked rock -> one deterministic variant sprite per mass cell (StableCellIndex, centered, live drawSize, overlapping like BM's walls), no link masks/corner fillers; unknown graphic classes -> flat MatSingle fill. Caches (atlas + variants) validated against live Graphic reference. EnsureQueue samples max across all standable terrain families (BelowQueueCeiling lesson). Vanilla atlas branch re-verified unchanged.
- Probe (`AB: probe ledge cell`) now reports fill branch/material/tint/queues per cell — keep this; it turned a three-way guess into a one-line verdict.

## PARITY TRANCHE — COMPLETE (runs #1-#15) — all USER-VERIFIED
Cross-level combat, ritual attendance, wild-animal wandering, universal targeting hub, sky-view mountain rendering. Pod transit + AA interception USER-VERIFIED run #39.

## 2026-07-21 FEATURE TRANCHE (runs #40-#47)
### 1. Destination-aware stair routing (Movement/StairRouter.cs) — BUILT, self-test in place
Whole-trip scoring with pawn-less PassDoors dest-side filter, never bricks. Wired: work/needs/joy/rest/food migration, medical + prisoner transport, haul verdict cache, fetch giver, right-click orders, attack chase, ritual gather, caravan gather. API dest overloads. Dev: `AB: stair-routing self-test`.
### 2. Biomes! Caverns basements — WORKING runs #41-#47
GenStep_ABCavernCarve (order 210): connected worm network + chambers; deep-scribed PrimaryBiome swap; weighted random (Fungal 50/Crystal 35/Earthen 15 — Earthen is 55C) or fixed. KNOWN-BENIGN: "Scatterer ... could not find cell" ~1x/gen. Dev: `AB: cavern-basement self-test`.
### 3. Naturalistic mountain peaks — verified through run #47; self-test green through run #53 on inherited biome
Meadow field Perlin 0.024 cutoff 0.60; lip ring locked; hidden valleys; arable + vegetation sliders; outcrop mounts; fade skirt vertex-alpha 0.8 c near-alpha 150. Dev: `AB: peak-plateau self-test`.
### 4. Camera level lock (QoL): `AB_CameraLevelLock` (default End); `cameraLockKeybind` setting.
### Fixes landed: run-40 wildPlants dictionary form; run-41 sky auto-roof guard NRE.

### Settings
naturalPeaks + peakSoilFraction + peakVegetation; skyBiomeInherit; cavernBasements + cavernBiome + cavernOpenness (BC-gated); cameraLockKeybind; belowDim (0.06), drawSlabEdge (hairlines), drawWallReveal + wallRevealWidth, belowThingScale. Scroll view.

### Roadmap
Ongoing: vanilla-API parity audit. Deferred: cell-targeted ability casts, beam turrets, scribed turret orders, multi-select formations, cross-level prisoner/animal ritual participation, T9 soak, T5 publishing. Watch: stalagmite density polish, cavern steady-state fauna respawn; BM mid-session settings changes only refresh cap sections on the next section dirty/regen (acceptable; document if reported).

## Dev-tools ("As above")
ensure sky+basement; cross-gap combat / auto-engage / targeting-hub / animal-wander / ritual-attendance / mech-overseer / bond+home / pod-transit / stair-routing / cavern-basement / peak-plateau self-tests; below-view diagnostic; probe ledge cell (T:, now with fill branch/material/queue report); toggle cap corner fillers.

## Prior verified features (unchanged)
Select pawns/items in place; bidirectional right-click orders + Reverse Commands; merged colonist bar; stairs/elevators; cross-level power/pipes; work/haul/supply/needs/medical/prisoners; see-below renderer; opt-in threats; world integration; modder API.

## Compat
DBH water riser, VEF generic duct, Rimefeller chem riser, VCHE chemfuel riser. Biomes! Caverns cavern basements (soft, defName-only). Better Mountains variant-mode rock rendering + full-size below rocks (soft, live-graphic detection; USER-VERIFIED). Medieval Overhaul rock formations in below view (USER-VERIFIED). Anti-air interception (verified #39). INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded. CE out of explicit scope.

## Status
2026-07-22: Compat tranche fully user-verified (BM+MO run and vanilla regression run both good); depth cues retired; below view plumb. Next: older outstanding items (mech overseer diagnosis, bond/home checks, VCHE companion run), soak (T9), publishing prep (T5).
